jobs.title: Client Account Manager
jobs.description:
Do you look for a new challenge within the dynamic and fast paced Wealth Management environment? Do you want to be part of a high performing team? Do you have a "can do" mentality and want to be part of our growth story and create impact? Are you curious, proactive and always striving to bring positive impact to clients?

We’re looking for a client account manager to:
• be the point of entry for processing client orders, e.g. stock orders, foreign exchange, loans and deposits
• be the direct contact for daily banking activities and administrative work for our clients
• perform account maintenance tasks and client-related processes; e.g. account opening and closing, suitability reviews, initial and recurring KYC and due diligence
• research, follow-up and resolve client inquiries and problems through effective interaction with clients, and internal partners in a timely and professional manner
• support client advisors in delivering exceptional client service and experience
• support client advisors in administrative, risk and legal and compliance related tasks and duties

jobs.title: Speditionsfachfrau/mann
jobs.description:
Arbeiten Sie gerne selbständig und sind Multitasking fähig? Möchten Sie uns helfen, unser Kundenerlebnis jetzt und in Zukunft zu verbessern? Sind Sie kundenorientiert und haben ein hohes Risikobewusstsein? Dann sind Sie in unserem Team genau richtig!

Im Bereich Investment Bank Operations sind wir die Experten welche für einen reibungslosen Ablauf im Tagesgeschäft sorgen. Unsere Vision ist es, das Erlebnis für unsere Kunden jetzt und in Zukunft zu verbessern. Um erfolgreich zu sein, müssen unsere Mitarbeiter:
• Höchstleistungen erbringen.
• Wissen, was unsere Kunden benötigen und wollen.
• Die Organisation voran bringen, indem Sie zielstrebig und leidenschaftlich arbeiten

Wir suchen eine neue Kollegin oder einen neuen Kollegen, welche(r) die folgenden Aufgaben übernehmen möchte:
• Interaktion mit externen Partnern/Kunden sowie Zollbehörde
• Mitarbeit in diversen Projekten und stetige Verbesserung der Arbeitsprozesse
• Mithilfe im Tagesgeschäft, welche folgende Tätigkeiten beinhalten:
 korrekte und speditive Ausführung von Edelmetall Inlandsendungen, Importe & Exporte
 OZL Abwicklung (Ein- und Ausgänge)
 Offertanfrage und Transportkalkulationen
 Raffinations- & Produktionsbereich (Abstimmungen)
 Überwachen, analysieren und wenn notwendig, richtigstellen der MwSt. Statistiken
 Erstellen und versenden der monatlichen und quartalsmässigen MwSt. Reporte
 Rechnungskontrolle (Debitoren/Kreditoren)

Leading with a client-first mindset, a successful candidate for this role will have strong interpersonal skills, immense attention to detail, and will be able to assist clients with their everyday needs.

• provide support for client relationship building and business development activities
• keep systems up-to-date with client information
• educate clients on account services and capabilities
• help with the preparation of reports and other materials for client meetings
• collect the right documentation for opening new accounts and service requests

jobs.title: Registered Client Associate
jobs.description:
The key tasks of your job as a Client Service Associate/Registered Client Service Associate include the following:

Relationship Management
• Educate clients on account services and capabilities (e.g., how to read statements/confirms, how to use Online Services, paperless options, RMA cards, etc.)
• Collect appropriate documentation to set up new accounts
• Leverage various communication channels to keep in touch with clients (e.g., send out birthday cards, e-mail research newsletters)
• Process account service requests and ensure appropriate documentation
• Direct incoming phone calls to appropriate team member

Wealth Management
• Input data into Financial Planning tools
• Input orders within appropriate system and complete associated paperwork, if registered
• Review daily branch reports and alerts and process accordingly
• Assist in the preparation of client reports and other materials for client meeting.

Practice Management
• Organize logistics of team marketing events, develop and maintain team marketing materials
• Maintain contact management systems with up to date key client information
• Provide team with up to date calendar including daily, weekly, and monthly activities

Talent Management
• Proactively develop self to continuously improve knowledge, skills and credentials and communicate development needs to Senior Financial Advisor or Team Administrator as applicable
• Assist with on-boarding new members to the team

jobs.description:
• Are you intellectually curious, analytically strong and keen to build a career in equity research?
• We are looking for a high-calibre Junior Analyst to join our Greater China Banks team. In this role, you will support senior analysts in delivering differentiated, high-quality research and develop the core skillset to become a sector specialist.
• This is an excellent opportunity for candidates with strong potential and a genuine interest in financial markets, even without prior full-time experience.
• Financial analysis and valuation support
Assist in building and maintaining financial models covering Greater China banks, including analysis of earnings, balance sheets, capital adequacy and asset quality
• Research production
Contribute to the preparation of earnings notes, sector updates and thematic research, ensuring clear and insightful communication of key investment views
• Market and industry monitoring
Track macroeconomic developments, regulatory changes and sector-specific trends; synthesize information into concise insights for the team and clients
• Investment idea development
Support the identification and evaluation of investment opportunities through data analysis, peer comparison and independent research
• Team collaboration
Work closely with senior analysts and sales teams to support client engagement, presentations and internal discussions

jobs.title: Local Credit Risk Officer, Korea
jobs.description:
Are you a strategic thinker with a passion for financial analysis and risk management?

We’re seeking a proactive and analytical (Director) to join our Investment Banking Risk Control team in Seoul. In this part-time role (50%), you will act as the UBS Securities, Seoul Branch CRO, which includes the following responsibilities:
• Chairing and preparing minutes for the local Risk Management Control Committee and attending monthly management meetings.
• Oversight and submission of regulatory reporting.
• Management of local liquidity risk management guidelines, involvement in the semi-annual liquidity stress test.
• Oversight of the monthly credit stress test.
• Internal/Regulatory inquiries related to Korea Risk in general.

jobs.title: Operations – Securities Specialist (Wealth Management)
jobs.description:
Your role
As part of Operations, you will play a critical role in ensuring the firm operates efficiently, with strong risk control and a seamless client experience.
You will be responsible for the accurate and timely execution of securities settlement and transaction processing activities, while contributing to continuous improvement and operational excellence.
In this role, you will:
• Process securities settlement and transaction processes with a high level of accuracy and timeliness
• Ensure strong adherence to controls, reconciliations, and regulatory requirements
• Act as a key escalation point for operational issues and support timely resolution
• Collaborate with internal stakeholders and external counterparties to manage transaction flows
• Identify inefficiencies and contribute to process improvements and automation initiatives
• Support digital transformation and continuous improvement within the function
• Promote a risk-aware, accountable, and collaborative team culture

We’re looking for a Securities Settlement Specialist to:
• Execute processes and controls in a timely, accurate, and complete manner
• Understand and manage risks associated with your business and function
• Work across teams and functions to identify the best solutions or courses of action
• Investigate issues and communicate effectively with internal teams and external counterparties
• Act as a first point of escalation for operational and people-related matters
• Proactively identify issues and drive timely resolution
• Collaborate effectively across teams to deliver optimal outcome

jobs.description:
"The SAP S/4HANA Finance Functional Delivery Lead supports the delivery of core SAP S/4HANA Finance capabilities within the ampliFi program, with primary accountability across General Ledger (GL), Group Reporting (GR), consolidation, reporting, and the broader Finance & Controlling (FI/CO) landscape. The role is responsible for driving disciplined execution across functional design, business validation, testing readiness, and production transition, ensuring that finance processes, close activities, and reporting outcomes are delivered in line with UBS accounting principles, governance, and control standards.
The role partners closely with Finance, Group Reporting and Consolidation teams, Data, Integration, and Technology stakeholders and acts as a functional representative for S/4HANA Finance within the delivery. It ensures that business requirements are translated into robust, well‑controlled finance solutions aligned with the target architecture and capable of supporting stable close, consolidation, and reporting cycles.

Key Responsibilities
- Support end‑to‑end functional delivery for assigned SAP S/4HANA Finance workstreams covering General Ledger, Group Reporting, consolidation, and reporting within the ampliFi finance stack, with clear ownership of outcomes.
- Contribute to and review functional designs and configurations across FI/CO to ensure alignment with agreed solution architecture, accounting principles, and reporting requirements.
- Ensure that S/4HANA Finance solutions support accurate posting, close, consolidation, and reporting outcomes, including integration with upstream subledgers and downstream reporting consumers.
- Develop and maintain delivery plans covering functional scope, milestones, dependencies, and impacts across S/4HANA Finance integration points and reporting consumption.
- Proactively manage risks, issues, and dependencies (RAID), with a focus on financial accuracy, close stability, consolidation integrity, and regulatory expectations, escalating where required.
- Coordinate day‑to‑day delivery across Finance, Group Reporting, Data, Integration, Testing, and Deployment teams to ensure coherent end‑to‑end execution across close, consolidation, and reporting cycles.
- Ensure adherence to agreed delivery standards, accounting principles, design decisions, and change control processes across the S/4HANA Finance scope.
- Support SIT and UAT execution from a functional perspective, including validation of close and consolidation scenarios, assessment of defects based on finance impact, and support for business sign‑off.
- Assist with production readiness and cutover preparation, focusing on stability of financial close and consolidation cycles, accuracy of balances and reports, and smooth transition to business‑as‑usual operations post go‑live.
"

jobs.title: Private Mortgage Banker
jobs.description:
Key competencies and responsibilities include:

• Mortgage Bankers are responsible for providing a premier client and financial advisor experience by providing expert advice, counsel and solution creation to solve client liability management needs
• Mortgage Bankers own the client experience and ensure that it is in line with UBS Bank USA's core value proposition. This is achieved by anticipating and exceeding the client and financial advisor's needs throughout all stages of the loan process
• Mortgage Bankers are responsible for building relationships with Financial Advisors and their respective teams in order to generate additional and ongoing direct referral business
• Mortgage Bankers work closely with UBS Banking Solutions Consultants (field sales) in order to develop comprehensive strategies customized towards serving the needs of each region's overall growth target and market strategy
• Mortgage bankers develop trust and deepen relationships for the firm by providing seamless mortgage origination and processing services ensuring that client objectives are met

Activities:

• Function as a single point of contact to clients and financial advisors throughout the loan process from end to end in a Telesales environment
• Manage active leads and loans to increase loan conversion rates resulting in higher firm revenue/profitability
• Proactively manage loan escalations as needed to ensure timely resolution, detailed communication to appropriate parties and participate in review post-mortem to ensure ongoing process improvement occurs
• Strengthen client retention by ensuring an outstanding client experience
• Proactively discuss and deliver solutions and referrals of UBS Bank USA offerings provided by other UBS groups and business divisions

jobs.description:
Do you know how to get the word out? Can you capture people's attention and keep them reading for more? We are looking for someone to help us:

• •Seek out and create opportunities for efficiency by assessing and improving current delivery systems and processes
• •Work effectively, efficiently, and rapidly as required to complete assignments and ensure that communications are delivered in a timely and paced manner

jobs.title: Trade Approval Analyst
jobs.description:
Do you thrive in fast paced environment? Do you quickly prioritize tasks with an eye for detail?

We are looking for someone like that who can:

• act as a supervisory risk control subject-matter expert for a centralized group that reviews incoming trades for accuracy
• perform first-line-of-defense activities by reviewing trades to help prevent errors, reduce financial and operational risk when entering trades, and to ensure proper documents and approvals are in place for higher risk trades.
• quickly and accurately assess trade risk with knowledge of account types, trading restrictions, and risk controls
• understands and is a subject matter expert in compliance with regulatory trading rules and operational requirements for complex situations
• build and maintain relationships with field partners to provide excellent and timely reviews while prioritizing client best interest

jobs.title: Head of Insurance & Annuity Solutions, Americas

titleByLocale.en: Head of Insurance & Annuity Solutions, Americas

jobs.description:
Are you a strategic leader with deep expertise in insurance and annuity solutions? We’re looking for somebody to lead our Insurance & Annuity Solutions business across the Americas, shaping the future of our platform and delivering a differentiated, advisor-centric experience. In this role, you’ll set the strategic direction and drive the continued growth of our insurance and annuity offering. You’ll lead high-performing product and sales specialist teams, ensuring seamless delivery, strong adoption, and an integrated approach to wealth solutions for our clients and financial advisors.
You will:
• provide leadership across Insurance & Annuity product and sales specialist teams, fostering a high-performance culture and supporting talent development
• drive the execution of strategic priorities and key initiatives aligned to broader business objectives
• act as a representative for the business, partnering with internal and external stakeholders at all levels
• partner with leadership across the firm to identify opportunities for growth, scale, and operational efficiency
• support field leadership and financial advisors by delivering expert guidance, tools, and hands-on leadership
• represent Insurance & Annuity Solutions in firm-wide initiatives, ensuring alignment with business priorities
• lead and optimize the end-to-end education and sales lifecycle, enhancing advisor engagement and client experience
• oversee the development and growth of Private Placement Insurance and Annuity solutions, ensuring strong integration within the broader platform
• champion the adoption of technology and tools to improve efficiency, scalability, and service delivery
• resolve complex service challenges and proactively mitigate risks impacting sales and client outcomes
• design and deliver training and education programs to ensure a consistent, advisor-friendly experience
• partner with Marketing to develop and execute initiatives that drive awareness, engagement, and growth
• collaborate cross-functionally with Central Supervision, Operations, Licensing, IT, and other key partners to ensure seamless execution

jobs.title: Credit Investment Group Portfolio Manager
jobs.description:
Do you want to use your expertise and portfolio management knowledge to help the Credit Investment Group identify new investment opportunities? Do you want to be a part of a growing business within a well-established asset management platform? We are looking for a Credit Investment Group Portfolio Manager to:
• design and implement investment strategies for leveraged loans and high yield bonds, ensuring optimal risk-adjusted returns within the fund’s mandate
• manage exposures across CLOs and loan accounts, considering liquidity, credit quality, and sector diversification
• conduct thorough credit analysis on potential investments, including reviewing financial statements, covenant structures, and market positioning
• assess issuer risk and make recommendations based on creditworthiness and expected performance
• execute buy and sell orders for leveraged loans and high yield bonds, maintaining appropriate documentation and ensuring compliance with internal and regulatory guidelines
• monitor portfolio risk metrics, including exposure concentrations, ratings migration, and default probabilities. Implement hedging strategies as needed, and proactively manage risks associated with CLO structures and underlying assets
• track portfolio performance, benchmark against relevant indices, and prepare detailed reports for internal stakeholders and external investors. Provide updates on market conditions, portfolio positioning, and anticipated changes
• ensure all portfolio activities comply with applicable regulations, fund documentation, and internal policies. Collaborate with compliance teams to maintain best practices and address regulatory changes
• support investor communications, including responding to queries, preparing presentations, and participating in due diligence meetings. Articulate fund strategy, performance, and outlook clearly and professionally
• work closely with analysts, traders, operations, and risk teams to ensure seamless management of the portfolio. Mentor junior team members and foster a culture of excellence and integrity

titleByLocale.en: Risk and Liquidity Manager – Investment Management Team

titleByLocale.de: Risk and Liquidity Manager – Investment Management Team
titleByLocale.fr: Risk and Liquidity Manager – Investment Management Team

jobs.description:
The Risk and Liquidity Manager is a critical member of the House View and OCIO teams, responsible for overseeing investment risk and liquidity management across diversified, multi-asset class portfolios. The House View portfolios are the core offerings to wealth management clients, while the OCIO portfolios serve a sophisticated institutional client base, including endowments, foundations, retirement plans, and ultra-high-net-worth families. This role supports the firm’s risk governance framework, delivers actionable insights to portfolio team, and ensures investment strategies align with client objectives and risk tolerances.

• Lead the identification, measurement, and monitoring of portfolio and aggregate client risk exposures, including market, credit, factor, interest rate, inflation, & currency risks.
• Design and implement forward-looking liquidity projections and stress testing across portfolios, incorporating both public and private market exposures.
• Manage selection, implementation, setup and testing of risk and analytics systems
• Develop and maintain risk analytics, dashboards, and reporting tools for use by House View portfolio managers, OCIO leadership, and client stakeholders.
• Conduct scenario analysis, value-at-risk (VaR), and tail-risk assessments using internal and third-party risk systems.
• Monitor redemption terms, lockups, and gating risks of underlying fund investments to ensure alignment with client liquidity needs and spending policies.
• Create liquidity models based on client/institutional spending needs and portfolio liquidity availability
• Serve as a subject matter expert in client meetings, delivering tailored risk and liquidity insights and supporting new client onboarding with modeling and analysis.
• Collaborate with investment and compliance teams to refine risk policies, investment guidelines, and portfolio construction parameters.
• Prepare and present risk reports to internal investment committees, audit and compliance teams, and client boards as needed
• Partner with technology, operations, and analytics teams to enhance risk reporting platforms, data pipelines, and ensure data integrity.
• Stay current on industry best practices, regulatory developments, and emerging risks relevant to institutional portfolios.

Your role

Are you incredibly organized with an eye for detail? Do you know how to take care of business?

We are looking for an Operations Specialist who will be responsible for end-to-end processing of paper and electronic check items cleared through the Federal Reserve, including posting adjustments, researching discrepancies, and processing Fed returns. • Maintain accurate records of investigations and resolutions in accordance with regulatory and internal standards.
• Identify trends or recurring issues and recommend process improvements.
• Support audit and compliance reviews by providing documentation and insights into investigation processes.

jobs.title: Head of Tax, Greater China
jobs.description:
Do you have a tax background in financial services or a chartered accountancy or law firm? Do you have a knack for breaking down complex issues to reach clear and concise conclusions? Are you able to interact with senior stakeholders and regulators? We’re looking for someone with tax expertise to help us:

• provide tax advice to the business divisions including Investment Bank, Asset Management and Global Wealth Management across UBS in Hong Kong, China, Taiwan and Korea regarding new business and change initiatives and complex transactions
• monitor tax reform issues impacting UBS
• interact effectively with senior management and staff across the different areas within the organisation
• manage relationships with tax authorities
• review tax effect accounting calculations and workpapers. This includes annual statutory reporting, and quarterly local and Swiss reporting
• work with the external service provider and Finance in supporting the annual corporate income tax process. Review the annual corporate income tax returns for all legal entities, including all disclosures, for the legal entities in jurisdictions under your responsibility
• review, update and compile the income tax manuals as required
• review the annual transfer pricing documentation for the jurisdictions under your responsibility
• review the annual local files under country by country reporting rules
• provide technical tax support into the wider APAC tax team where required, including supporting sign off to APAC Regional Tax for business advisory and new business initiatives
